issues.explanation: Test file calls Event::fake/assertDispatched but has no `use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;` import, so those two tests would error.
Layout file exists but Livewire components never apply it via layout()/#[Layout] and auth Blade views render as fragments without a layout.
Livewire components validate via $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate] attributes or rules() method required by the project pattern.
Reset-password store validates three fields inline instead of a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Translation files triplicate identical verify/verification/email_verification blocks plus flat verification_sent keys.
Duplicate translation sections force future edits in three places and obscure which key views actually use.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:submit uses `$this->validate([...])` with no `#[Validate]`; app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:store validates token/email/password inline (3 fields); layouts/app.blade.php exists but Login.php:render `view(...)->title(...)` never applies a layout

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php, LogoutController.php, PasswordResetLinkController.php: small focused __invoke/create/store methods with clear names; views use `{{ }}` and `route()` consistently

requirements.evidence: Met: Login strict email + auth.failed/auth.throttle + 5-try key + regenerate + intended home (Login.php:submit); Register Password::defaults + confirmed + register|ip key + Registered + login (Register.php:submit); logout invalidate/regenerateToken; home auth+verified; forgot always passwords.sent + throttle:6,1; reset single name=email + remember_token rotation + PasswordReset; verify 403 on tampered id + MustVerifyEmail; pt_BR/en ui + phpunit pins. Gap: layouts/app.blade.php created but never wired to Livewire full-page components/auth views

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves task.md: .env.example/phpunit locale pins, ui.php translations, auth controllers/routes/views, User MustVerifyEmail, Password::defaults, AuthenticationTest; welcome/bulma-test edits required by req 8-9; no unrelated features

security.evidence: No exploitable flaw: Login/Register RateLimiter 5-try keys (Str::lower email|ip, register|ip); VerifyEmailController aborts 403 on id/hash mismatch + signed+throttle routes; logout auth + invalidate + regenerateToken; `{{ }}` escaping; Fillable preserved; email:strict everywhere

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password::defaults(), Password::reset/sendResetLink, standard verification controllers; lean routes/views. Deduction: lang/en/ui.php + lang/pt_BR/ui.php duplicate verify/verification/email_verification arrays verbatim

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/AuthenticationTest.php covers login pt_BR/en, auth redirect, login success/fail/rate-limit, register success/event/confirmation/rate-limit, logout, home gates, forgot status+throttle, reset single-email + rotation, verify success/tamper/resend/verified, password rule, named-route check; missing Event facade import breaks 2 tests; no authenticated-submit unauthorized test for Livewire actions

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR session auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, home gates, forgot/reset, verification, localization, named routes) with correct throttling and security checks. Needs changes before merging because the test file misses the Event import and the new Blade layout is never applied to Livewire/auth pages, plus Livewire validation skips the required #[Validate] pattern.
